nodes.name: Kafka Trigger
nodes.notes: Upstash Kafka was sunset in 2025. If you use QStash or a plain HTTP producer, replace this node with a Webhook node (POST, JSON body {application_id,user_id,timestamp}) - nothing downstream changes.

parameters.query:
-- Optional: add behaviour_* boolean columns (behaviour_paid_previous_loan_early, behaviour_missed_payments_before, ...) from TerePay's loan history; they are used as the authoritative Borrower Behaviour Scorecard ticks.
SELECT id, applicant_name, loan_amount, interest_rate, income, expenses, existing_debt, loan_purpose, created_at
FROM loan_applications
WHERE id = $1

parameters.queryString: =name = '{{ $json.id }}' and mimeType = 'application/vnd.google-apps.folder' and '{{ $env.GOOGLE_DRIVE_ROOT_FOLDER_ID }}' in parents and trashed = false
='{{ $json.id }}' in parents and mimeType = 'application/pdf' and trashed = false

nodes.name: Extract PDF Text
nodes.notes: Image-only (scanned) PDFs yield no text and are reported as 'unreadable'. Add an OCR step (ocrmypdf/tesseract) before this node if that happens often.

nodes.name: Analyse Statements
nodes.notes: Deterministic transaction parser + metrics (statement-analysis.js). The LLM never counts; every number here is reproducible and stored in analysis_json.

nodes.name: Call LLM
nodes.notes: LLM_BACKEND=ollama -> /api/chat with format:json; LLM_BACKEND=openai -> /v1/chat/completions with response_format json_object (llama.cpp llama-server). Request is built in Prepare LLM Prompt.

nodes.name: Parse & Score
nodes.notes: Merges deterministic metrics with the model's judgement calls, then applies TerePay's scoring matrix (scoring.js).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ application_id: $('Parse & Score').first().json.application_id, assessment_id: $json.id, risk_rating: $json.risk_rating, recommendation: $json.recommendation, confidence_score: $json.confidence_score, escalation: $json.escalation, expense_risk_tier: $json.expense_risk_tier, behaviour_score: $json.behaviour_score, parser_mode: $json.parser_mode, completed_at: $json.created_at }) }}
